notes.title: Steam Game Festival is over. The Demo is still available!
notes.notes:
It's time to take stock of Steam Game Festival! We are glad to welcome new players to the Battle Blocks virtual world! During the past week, hundreds of new players tried out the demo, competed in epic battles and broke their PBs grinding solo! Special thanks to everyone who gave us feedback. This is invaluable without exaggeration. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1vbuaxq.gif[/img]

Seeing you enjoying the game is our highest reward. That's why we decided to extend the party and make the demo available for one more week! More news is coming. Meanwhile, have fun and stay tuned!

P.S.: I'd like to remind everyone reading this to join the Battle Blocks [url=https://discord.gg/fyeQ9aJ]Discord[/url]! This is the #1 place to get updates.

notes.title: Battle Blocks Live Stream
notes.notes:
Join us here on February 8th at 11am PST, where we will be live streaming Battle Blocks with the community! We are happy to invite you to participate!

Try out the Demo

We invite you to play the demo during of the Steam Festival to get a glimpse of the basics of Battle Blocks! Our Dev team will join the party to give you an overview and just to hang out with the community. Learn how to play competitive block-stacking matches, try to defeat us and just have fun!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/96vMZTb.gif[/img]

Battle Blocks is a fresh take on a multiplayer block-stacking, designed specifically for VR. Enjoy unique competitive gameplay — stack and clear layers of blocks to push your opponent out of the field. Meet new friends, play, and have fun. Compete, and become a champion!
